Referral rewards, game-based coin collection, and payment-gateway setup are shown as app functions, but an unset gateway and zero-dollar balance do not establish a completed withdrawal or verified payment. The unclear PayPal passage, separate IELTS advertisement, and educational disclaimer support treating the material as a tutorial with unverified claims rather than the creator's own fraudulent solicitation.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The central demonstrated earning features are referral and game-based coin rewards: the app offers coins when friends join using a referral ID and presents in-app play options with a coin-collection result. This classifies the observed rewards context, without verifying that coins can be redeemed or that the claimed payment occurred.
